title: School Choice Problems with Priority Adjustments
abstract: arXiv:2609.12558v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper studies school choice when each school has an original priority order and an adjusted priority order reflecting policies such as affirmative action. We introduce a weak notion of stability that permits justified envy under one priority order only when the opposite priority relation is supported by the other. We characterize weakly stable matchings as stable matchings under the intersection of the two priority profiles. Using the efficiency-adjusted deferred acceptance algorithm, we obtain a weakly stable matching that cannot be Pareto improved upon, within the set of weakly stable matchings, for any group containing all improved students by the adjustment. We also show that any Pareto improvement over this outcome necessarily creates justified envy under both priority profiles. Finally, our mechanism is responsive to stronger priority adjustments: the outcome under a stronger affirmative action policy is not Pareto dominated b

translated_title: 具有优先权调整的学校选择问题
translated_abstract: 本文研究当每所学校同时拥有一个原始优先顺序和一个反映平权行动等政策的调整后优先顺序时的学校选择问题。我们引入了一个弱稳定性概念，该概念允许在一个优先顺序下存在合理嫉妒，但仅当相反的优先关系得到另一个顺序支持时才被允许。我们将弱稳定匹配刻画为在两个优先档案交集下的稳定匹配。通过使用效率调整的延迟接受算法，我们得到了一个弱稳定匹配，该匹配在弱稳定匹配集合内，对于任何包含所有因调整而受益学生的群体，都无法进行帕累托改进。我们还证明了，对该结果的任何帕累托改进必然会在两个优先档案下都产生合理嫉妒。最后，我们的机制对更强的优先权调整具有响应性：在更强的平权行动政策下得到的结果不会被（较弱政策下的结果）帕累托支配。
tldr: 本文提出了一种适用于优先权调整（如平权行动）学校选择问题的弱稳定性概念，将弱稳定匹配刻画为两个优先档案交集下的稳定匹配，并利用效率调整的延迟接受算法获得了对受益学生群体无法帕累托改进的弱稳定匹配，同时该机制能够响应更强的优先权政策调整。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a weak stability notion for school choice with priority adjustments (such as affirmative action), characterizes weakly stable matchings as stable matchings under the intersection of two priority profiles, and uses the efficiency-adjusted deferred acceptance algorithm to obtain a weakly stable matching that cannot be Pareto improved upon for groups containing all benefited students, while the mechanism responds monotonically to stronger priority adjustments.
